ledger_boundary.additional: saved storage excluding parameter/slot/input/incoming-state ownership at segment boundary; outgoing state can still overlap

ledger_boundary.unclassified: same-instant live allocator minus visible storage union; not operator scratch alone or hardware bandwidth

sampled before diagnostic reset, includes previous warmup/history; exclude this value when reporting diagnostic-segment peak
cumulative from reset immediately after boundary, not per-phase increments
